function.money_saving_desc: Set 8 hours of electricity use at night for comfortable and energy-saving all night
function.boot_customization_desc: Users can set the operating parameters when turning on the air conditioner, and automatically apply the previously set parameters the next time it is turned on, achieving one-click entry into the optimal comfort environment
function.smart_sleep_desc: Provides three major functions: human sleep, sleep customization, and sleep mode, creating a personalized comfortable sleep environment

function.self_learning_desc: After enabling the self-learning function, the air conditioner will automatically adjust parameters such as temperature and wind speed according to the user's usage habits
function.beep_desc: After the beep is turned on, the air conditioner will respond with a beep after receiving a control command

body_detect.title: Smart Human Detection
body_detect.intro_desc: The air conditioner is equipped with a millimeter-wave radar module that can intelligently sense the position of people in real time, currently recognizing up to three people simultaneously. When the AI human detection function is enabled, the white light in the top light strip will change according to the movement of people. When multiple people move, only the person closest is displayed.
body_detect.wind_follow_desc: The millimeter-wave radar intelligently senses the position of the human body and automatically adjusts the wind direction according to the movement of the human body. Wherever the person goes, the wind follows.
body_detect.wind_avoid_desc: The millimeter-wave radar intelligently senses the position of the human body and automatically adjusts the wind direction according to the movement of the human body to achieve the effect of wind avoiding people.
body_detect.human_near_soft_desc: The millimeter-wave radar intelligently senses the position of the human body. When it detects someone approaching, it automatically turns on the soft wind.
body_detect.distance_control_desc: The millimeter-wave radar intelligently senses the position of the human body. When it detects movement, it automatically adjusts the wind speed and direction.
body_detect.activity_area_desc: According to the wind blows/avoids human setting, perform area sweep wind or area wind avoidance for frequently active areas.
body_detect.no_people_desc: When the air conditioner detects no one in the area via millimeter-wave radar, it automatically reduces energy consumption to save power.
body_detect.human_near_light_desc: When the air conditioner detects someone approaching (about 2 meters) via millimeter-wave radar, it automatically lights up the screen. If no one is near, the screen turns off after 2 minutes.

1. If you fail to learn the wake word twice in a row, you will exit the wake word learning mode and need to start again
2. Each wake word learning session lasts 10 seconds. If the air conditioner does not receive the custom wake word command within 10 seconds, it will automatically exit the wake word learning mode
3. If you forget the custom wake word, you can use the command 'Clear Wake Word' or 'Delete Wake Word' to delete the custom wake word, or directly use 'Start learning wake word' to relearn the wake word
4. To prevent false wakeups, please avoid using reduplicated words or consecutive homophones
5. Please use 4-6 Chinese characters as the wake word, and try to avoid daily language and repeated words

electricity_stats.pv_operating_instructions:
1.PV Power Supply Characteristics: PV power supply mode depends on light conditions, operating only during daylight hours with sunlight. Output power varies dynamically with light intensity — reaching peak on sunny days, dropping to 10%-30% on cloudy/rainy days, and ceasing entirely at night.
2.Automatic Grid Backup: When PV power is insufficient or unavailable, the air conditioner will automatically switch to grid power to ensure continuous operation. This function relies on normal local grid supply; the air conditioner will stop working if the grid is interrupted or malfunctions.
3.Usage Reminder: Users shall independently confirm local power supply and light conditions, and reasonably estimate electricity costs. The above function descriptions are based on conventional scenarios; actual operating mode and availability are subject to real-time weather and grid status.
4.Note: Electricity consumption data (including but not limited to PV/Grid consumption,PV Savings,Rate setting) is derived from user-provided information and/or device statistics. Such data may be inaccurate due to device statistical deviations, data update delays, or other objective factors, and is for reference only.

dr.title: DR
dr.intro_1: 1.Demand Response (DR) is a key mechanism in the power system that connects the supply side with the user side.
dr.intro_2: 2.The core function is to dynamically respond to the supply and demand changes, price signals or emergency situations of the power grid by guiding or adjusting users' electricity consumption behaviors.
dr.intro_3: 3.Ensure the safe, economical and efficient operation of the power grid.
dr.intro_4: 4. When the Demand Response function is activated, the equipment receives instructions issued by the power grid to perform peak frequency regulation. Users can terminate a single grid dispatching response, and will not respond to frequency regulation until the next grid instruction is issued. When the Demand Response function is deactivated, the equipment will not respond to grid frequency regulation at all.
dr.desc_1: After being turned on, the function can operate automatically according to the instructions from the power grid.

ai_body_detect.wind_distance_tips: (Requires Human Near Soft Wind and Human Far Strong Wind)
ai_body_detect.soft_wind_tips: When the radar detects someone within the comfort air range, soft wind turns on automatically. In multi-person scenarios, the nearest person is prioritized.
ai_body_detect.strong_wind_tips: Adjust the fan speed according to the distance between the user and the air conditioner
ai_body_detect.save_energy_tips: Automatically adjust the temperature to save power when no one is detected continuously, and restore the original settings when someone is detected.
ai_body_detect.control_wind_tips: Automatically deliver precise air supply or wind avoidance to frequently active areas when no one is detected continuously.
ai_body_detect.wind_follow_guide: The radar automatically blows air towards people based on their positions; swing mode is activated automatically when there are multiple people
ai_body_detect.wind_aviod_guide: The radar automatically blows air away from people based on their positions.
ai_body_detect.function_intro: The radar can intelligently sense human body position to realize functions such as wind blowing towards people and wind avoiding people, and preferentially identifies the person closest to the air conditioner.
ai_body_detect.function_tips: Note: people below 1.2m in height cannot be sensed in the yellow area.
ai_body_detect.function_guide_1: 1. Different models have different radar recognition angles, with a maximum recognition distance of 5-6 meters. Limited by detection height and blind spots, you may not be recognized if you are in a low position and close to the device.
ai_body_detect.function_guide_2: 2. The radar can detect moving targets, while stationary targets may not be recognized. For example: when a person remains motionless for a long time (such as in sleep state), the radar may determine no one is present due to failure to detect movement, and target detection can be restored by shaking the head, waving hands and other actions.
ai_body_detect.function_guide_3: 3. The following situations may cause radar misjudgment:
ai_body_detect.function_guide_3_paragraph_1: · There are continuously moving non-human targets within the detection range, such as pets, oscillating fans, sweeping robots, green plants or curtains swinging greatly at the air outlet, etc.;
ai_body_detect.function_guide_3_paragraph_2: · There are large-area strong reflection objects or strong reflection planes (such as large metal surfaces) in the sensing area that interfere with radar signals.
ai_body_detect.function_guide_4:
4.The AI Human Sensor function relies on millimeter-wave radar to detect information including human position, angle, distance, number of people, and zonal activity level. It is used to deliver wind direction adjustments such as directing airflow toward or away from users and achieve intelligent air control effects.
This function captures human‑related signals locally on the air conditioner via millimeter-wave radar, and raw radar data is processed in real time only on the device itself.Human position analysis results generated by the on-device algorithm are uploaded to the cloud in real time and deleted immediately after use on the cloud side. They are temporarily used solely to display the real-time human position in the room on the APP interface, and will not be used for other purposes such as product algorithm improvement, user profiling, or marketing, nor will they be shared with third parties.You may disable the AI Human Sensor function at any time to withdraw your consent.
ai_body_detect.tutorial_step1_desc: The air conditioner is equipped with a millimeter wave radar. After enabling "AI Human Sensor",this area will display the detected people and their positions in real-time.
ai_body_detect.tutorial_step2_desc: After enabling "AI Human Sensor",it can intelligently sense human positions,providing you with a comfortable air supply and smart ECO experience. Start using it now!
ai_body_detect.agreement_text_1: When enabled, the air conditioner can intelligently detect human positions via millimeter-wave radar to provide functions such as directing airflow toward or away from you. Raw radar data is processed locally only; human position analysis results are uploaded to the cloud in real time and deleted immediately after use, solely for simulating and displaying human positions in the app.
ai_body_detect.agreement_text_2: Tap “{}” to learn more about how your data is used. You may disable this feature at any time to withdraw your consent.

ai_sleep.ai_sleep_auth_desc_1: After enabling, the air conditioner uses millimeter-wave radar to detect sleep status and automatically adjust temperature/ fan speed. Original radar data is processed locally. Sleep status data (body movement value, wake-up and sleep time, etc.) and temperature adjustment records will be uploaded to the cloud.
ai_sleep.ai_sleep_auth_desc_1_paragraph_1: ·AI sleep: Runs automatically every day after enabling and takes permanent effect, generating exclusive sleep reports. When the device is networked, activating sleep via remote control/voice will default to this mode.
ai_sleep.ai_sleep_auth_desc_1_paragraph_2: ·Normal Sleep: Automatically turns off after running for 8 hours with no sleep reports generated. When the device is offline, activating sleep via remote control/voice will default to this mode.
ai_sleep.ai_sleep_auth_desc_2: Tap "{}" and "{}" to learn more about how sleep features collect and process your personal information.
ai_sleep.guide_step1_desc: The millimeter-wave radar in your air conditioner automatically detects your sleep status and intelligently adjusts temperature and fan speed.It provides you with a customized, unobtrusive and comfortable sleep experience all night
ai_sleep.guide_step2_desc: Enjoy 8 hours of effortless sleep with intelligent temperature and fan control throughout,creating a cozy and timed restful sleeping environment
ai_sleep.function_desc_1: 1.AI Sleep / Normal Sleep relies on millimeter-wave radar to perceive sleep status and body movements. After recognizing that you have fallen asleep, it will dynamically adjust parameters such as air conditioner temperature and fan speed based on the sleep curve algorithm and your temperature preferences. An exclusive sleep report will be generated for you if AI Sleep is enabled.
ai_sleep.function_desc_2: 2.The function perceives body movement signals locally on the air conditioner through millimeter-wave radar, and raw radar and body movement signal data will only be processed locally. Result data generated by local algorithms such as sleep/wake-up status and time nodes, body movement energy value, abnormal body movement, as well as AI Sleep target temperature and actual heating/cooling temperature will be uploaded to the cloud for:
ai_sleep.function_desc_2_paragraph_1: ·Automatically adjusting air conditioner temperature and fan speed according to your sleep status to provide a comfortable sleeping environment;
ai_sleep.function_desc_2_paragraph_2: ·Displaying your sleep curve and report of the past 7 days in the APP when AI Sleep is enabled;
ai_sleep.function_desc_3: 3.Relevant data of AI Sleep report and data reported by Normal Sleep will be permanently deleted after being stored in the cloud for 7 days, and will only be used for intelligent temperature adjustment and sleep report display, not for other purposes such as product algorithm optimization, user profiling, marketing, or shared with third parties. You can turn off AI Sleep at any time to withdraw your consent.
ai_sleep.function_desc_4: 4.Both AI Sleep and Normal Sleep adopt millimeter-wave radar and dynamically adjust parameters such as air conditioner temperature and fan speed, with the differences as follows:
ai_sleep.function_desc_4_paragraph_1: ·AI Sleep: Runs automatically every day after being enabled and takes effect continuously;
ai_sleep.function_desc_4_paragraph_2: ·Normal Sleep: Needs to be manually enabled every day and only runs for 8 hours per single use.
ai_sleep.function_desc_5: 5. When sleep mode is activated via remote control/voice command, the device will enable [AI Sleep] if network-configured, otherwise enable [Normal Sleep].
